Aggregate cell indicators to administrative divisions

Source: R/aggregate_to_adm.R
aggregate_to_adm.Rd

Averages cell-level indicators within each administrative division, weighting each cell by the share of it inside the division (coverage_fraction from extract_cell_by_poly()). Replaces agg_to_adm_div().

Usage

aggregate_to_adm(
  x,
  cols = NULL,
  extra_col = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  weights = "coverage_fraction"
)

Arguments

x

A table of cell-level indicators with a coverage column.

cols

<tidy-select> Columns to average; by default the registered indicators.

extra_col

<tidy-select> Columns carried through; they must be constant within each division.

id

Optional name of the division column; by default ID_adm_div.

weights

Name of the weight column.

Value

A c4e_tbl with one row per division (and lag or date).

Details

Rows are grouped by the division and, when present, by lag, the date, month or period. On daily flags this gives the share of the division's area beyond the threshold each day; summed over a window by summarise_by_interview(), it gives area-weighted days.

The columns averaged are the registered indicators by default.

Examples

tmax <- read_climate(system.file("extdata", "tmax_daily.tif", package = "c4e"))
#> Read tmax_daily: tmax [K], daily, 2021-01-01 to 2023-12-31, 1095 layers
#> (synthetic).
adm_div <- terra::vect(system.file("extdata", "adm_div.gpkg", package = "c4e"))

extract_cell_by_poly(tmax[[1:10]], adm_div) |>
  calc_threshold_day(above = 300) |>
  aggregate_to_adm()
#> Using `unit = "K"` from upstream unit.
#> # A tibble: 30 × 4
#> # Context:  tmax [K], day, long; key ID_adm_div; 2 indicators
#>    ID_adm_div date       day_abv_300 K_abv_300
#>    <chr>      <date>           <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1 1          2021-01-01           0         0
#>  2 1          2021-01-02           0         0
#>  3 1          2021-01-03           0         0
#>  4 1          2021-01-04           0         0
#>  5 1          2021-01-05           0         0
#>  6 1          2021-01-06           0         0
#>  7 1          2021-01-07           0         0
#>  8 1          2021-01-08           0         0
#>  9 1          2021-01-09           0         0
#> 10 1          2021-01-10           0         0
#> # ℹ 20 more rows
